summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine director and PDMR share transactions. Independent Non-Executive Director Wendy Becker purchased 4,000 ordinary shares at £19.6291 per share on the London Stock Exchange. Chief People Officer Diana Conrad acquired 12.874 American Depositary Shares under the GSK pension plan at $54.5854 per ADS on the NYSE. Both transactions are ordinary-course equity transactions by insiders, not related to any special situation. No deal terms apply; this is a standard disclosure of insider dealings under UK and SEC rules, without any strategic corporate event.
